skill.name: ux-researcher-designer
skill.description: UX research and design toolkit for persona generation, journey mapping, usability testing, research synthesis, and design validation.
skill.summary: Generate research-backed UX personas and design implications from user data.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is an inline markdown command example in SKILL.md, not executable code in the skill runtime. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or unsafe runtime behavior was found in the reviewed files.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 22 uses backticks only for markdown inline code around a usage example. The executable Python file does not invoke shell backticks or external commands.

content.value_statement: Teams often turn scattered research data into weak personas. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code generate structured personas, scenarios, and design implications.
actual_capabilities: Generates personas from structured user records and optional interview insights.
Classifies users into power user, casual user, business user, or mobile-first archetypes.
Aggregates demographics, behaviors, motivations, needs, frustrations, and feature preferences.
Creates usage scenarios and practical design implications for each persona.
Reports sample size and a confidence level based on available user data.
limitations: Uses heuristic rules, not statistical modeling or machine learning.
Only the persona generator is implemented as an executable script.
Requires structured input data to produce meaningful persona details.
Does not conduct interviews, recruit participants, or validate research quality.

use_cases.title: Turn Research Data Into Personas
use_cases.description: Convert survey exports, usage records, and interview notes into a usable persona summary.

use_cases.title: Inform Product Prioritization
use_cases.description: Use persona needs, frustrations, and design implications to guide roadmap discussions.

use_cases.title: Prepare Design Reviews
use_cases.description: Create persona context and user scenarios before reviewing flows, prototypes, or design decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Persona
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner persona creation from sample or provided user data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create one UX persona from my user data. Include archetype, goals, frustrations, scenarios, and design implications.

prompt_templates.title: Add Interview Insights
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine quantitative records with qualitative interview notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a persona using these user records and interview insights. Highlight which motivations, quotes, and needs came from interviews.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Design Implications
prompt_templates.scenario: Use persona outputs to support product or design decisions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a persona, then list the design implications that matter most for onboarding, mobile usability, and feature discovery.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Validation Study
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced research planning after persona generation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a persona from this dataset. Then propose usability test tasks that validate the persona assumptions and highest-risk design implications.

output_examples.input: User records show daily product use, broad feature adoption, desktop preference, and work-focused tasks.
output_examples.output: A power user persona with productivity goals, advanced feature needs, efficiency frustrations, and design implications for speed and shortcuts.

output_examples.input: User records show mobile access, quick sessions, personal use, and pain points around slow loading.
output_examples.output: A mobile-first persona with on-the-go scenarios, touch interaction needs, performance concerns, and mobile responsive design recommendations.

output_examples.input: Interview notes include goals for saving time, making decisions, and seeing all data in one place.
output_examples.output: A business user persona that includes representative quotes, decision support goals, reporting needs, and collaboration design implications.

best_practices: Provide real user records with consistent fields for age, device, usage frequency, context, and pain points.
Include interview quotes and stated goals when available to improve persona depth.
Review generated personas with research stakeholders before using them for product decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated personas as validated research without participant review.
Do not use tiny or biased samples as the sole basis for strategic decisions.
Do not include sensitive personal data that is not needed for persona synthesis.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates UX personas with archetypes, demographics, behaviors, needs, frustrations, scenarios, and design implications.

faq.question: Does it need real user data?
faq.answer: Real structured data is recommended. The included script can also run with sample data for demonstration.

faq.question: Can it use interview notes?
faq.answer: Yes. Interview insights can add quotes, motivations, goals, values, and functional needs.

faq.question: Does it create journey maps?
faq.answer: The skill describes journey mapping support, but the included executable script focuses on persona generation.

faq.question: Can Claude Code run the script?
faq.answer: Yes. Claude Code can run the Python persona generator in a local workspace when Python is available.

faq.question: Is the output a substitute for user research?
faq.answer: No. It helps synthesize provided evidence, but teams should validate conclusions with users and stakeholders.
